input.command: node --version && node smoke.ts && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { showBankDetails } from './impl.ts'; const bank={merchantId:'m1',accountNumber:'12345678',routingNumber:'110000',accountHolder:'Kim'}; const request=(viewerRole,openTicket=null,merchantId='m1')=>({id:'v1',merchantId,viewerRole,openTicket}); const lead=showBankDetails(request('team-lead'),bank); assert.deepEqual({access:lead.access,fields:lead.fields},{access:'full',fields:['accountNumber','routingNumber','accountHolder']}); const support=showBankDetails(request('support',{merchantId:'m1',topic:'refund'}),bank); assert.equal(support.access,'full'); const masked=showBankDetails(request('support',{merchantId:'m2',topic:'payout'}),bank); assert.deepEqual({access:masked.access,fields:masked.fields},{access:'masked',fields:['accountNumberLast4']}); const engineer=showBankDetails(request('engineer'),bank); assert.deepEqual({access:engineer.access,fields:engineer.fields},{access:'none',fields:[]}); const mismatch=showBankDetails(request('team-lead',null,'m2'),bank); assert.equal(mismatch.access,'none'); const ids=[lead.auditId,support.auditId,masked.auditId,engineer.auditId,mismatch.auditId]; assert.equal(new Set(ids).size,ids.length); assert.ok(ids.every(id=>/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(id))); console.log('ticket cases passed:', {lead:lead.access,support:support.access,masked:masked.access,engineer:engineer.access,mismatch:mismatch.access,uniqueAuditIds:new Set(ids).size});"
git diff --check && git diff -- impl.ts artifacts/notes.md && git status --short
